name: Sultan Abdul Aziz Shah Airport (Subang)

runway.v: one runway, 15/33, 3,782 m long and 45 m wide

customs.v: customs and immigration from 07:00 to 23:00 local time (2300-1500 UTC)

hours.v: aerodrome open 24 hours; terminal building 05:00 to 24:00 local time (2100-1600 UTC), outside that on 24 hours' prior permission from Malaysia Airports
hours.quote: Terminal building OPR BTN 2100 - 1600. Outside this time, terminal building available on 24 hr PPR from Malaysia Airport Sdn. Bhd.

handling.v: by arrangement with an authorised handling agent (no agents named in the AIP)
handling.quote: By arrangement with authorized handling agent.

max_aircraft.v: stands on taxilane P1 at bays 1-4 and 13-14 are limited to aircraft with a wingspan of 28 m or less
max_aircraft.quote: Aircraft stand taxilane P1 from Bay 1 until Bay 4 and Bay 13 until Bay 14 is restricted for aircraft wing span 28 m and below.

missing: curfew (no night restriction for business aviation stated)
notes: AIP times are UTC; Malaysia is UTC+8 with no DST, so conversions are fixed. A later edition (AIRAC 6 Aug 2026 / 11 Aug 2026) exists but its WMSA page could not be opened; facts are from the 19 May 2026 edition. Slots for all Malaysian airports are covered at country level (GEN 1.2, NSCM).
